Variants.Content: Willow City is located near the river ground and water network. The place name comes from the willow trees that are common on low wet river banks. The willows, mills, ferries and fertile fields of the Riverland constitute a gentle and fragile abundance: the river water brings irrigation, fish and transportation, but can also become a boundary that blocks roads and floods fields during heavy rains or wars. A local stronghold like Willow City does not have to have the huge shadow of Harrenhal, but it can also affect the safety of an area through warehouses, bridges, farmers and local knights. What seemed like a peaceful riverbank in spring and summer could become a bivouac, a crossing point, or a target for burning when troops were on the move.

Entry Willow Wood If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

From workshops to sanctuaries, Willow City juxtaposes boats, bridges, millstones, fishing nets, and riverside sanctuaries with the memory of seven gods, ancient legends of river kings, and the memory of a land that changed hands over and over again. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Willow Wood They care about river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war comes. They also care about whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
